predecessors.name: Serbia and Montenegro (Federal Republic of Yugoslavia)
predecessors.text: Kosovo, placed under transitional UN administration on 10 June 1999 after the Kosovo War

ledger.x: June 1999: Kosovo passes under UN administration.
ledger.cpn: Serbia and Montenegro (Federal Republic of Yugoslavia)

wars.name: Kosovo War
wars.outcome: The war ended with the Kumanovo Agreement of 9 June 1999; Yugoslav forces pulled out and Kosovo came under UN Resolution 1244 and the NATO-led KFOR, with no de jure change to Yugoslav borders.

certainty.note: The outer line is the provincial boundary of Kosovo inside Yugoslavia, which Cliopatria draws; the pages opened give no survey or demarcation date.
